title: Matrix Transpose
statement: Read two integers r and c on the first line - the number of rows and columns. Then read r lines, each containing c space-separated integers, representing an r x c matrix. Print the transpose of the matrix: c lines, each containing r space-separated integers, where row i of the output is column i of the input.
